purpose: Research-only longitudinal evidence gate input for Layer 2 observables. Does not modify production assessment or sparse.channelOutcome.
productionMappingRootCause: ds4-trip-assessment-v1.engine sets assessment.evidenceQuality := payload.contract.sparse.channelOutcome; sparse.channelOutcome is R1_OBD manifest outcome only (NOT_APPLICABLE for API_SYNTHETIC).
consumersTraced: ds4-assessment-driving-exposure.v1 (FSM label evidenceQuality DIRECT — separate axis, not L2 gate)

axes.r1ObdApplicability: S4 channel policy: R1_OBD applicable only for RUPTELA_R1; API_SYNTHETIC => NOT_APPLICABLE (informational, not longitudinal pass for synthetic family)
axes.positionAvailability: POSITION channel outcome from pinned manifest; required for API_SYNTHETIC pass but never sufficient alone
axes.speedAuthorityValidity: Motion payload contract.speedAuthority must be C4_ONLY or C5_1_PREFERRED (not AMBIGUOUS); recorded separately — no cross-source substitution
axes.temporalContinuity: Assessment drivingExposure.derivable with qualifyingIntervalCount > 0 and canonicalSpeedSeriesMissing false; motion FSM DIRECT label count > 0
axes.motionEventQuality: At least one rated intensity event (ratedEventCount >= 1) on assessment summaries
axes.sparseComparability: Observed from motion adaptation; informational for API_SYNTHETIC — not required for pass (C4/C5.1 speed series is authoritative for synthetic longitudinal path)
axes.missingDegraded: Fail-closed on missing exposure, missing position PRESENT, ambiguous speed authority, or zero temporal/event signal

semantics.PASS: longitudinalL2InputEvidenceQuality = PRESENT with documented reasonCodes; sparse.channelOutcome unchanged
semantics.FAIL: longitudinalL2InputEvidenceQuality != PRESENT; reasonCodes list failing predicates
semantics.NOT_EVALUABLE: Required assessment summary fields absent (null/ malformed drivingExposure or eventSummaries)

RUPTELA_R1.longitudinalL2InputEvidenceQuality: sparse.channelOutcome unchanged (must be literal PRESENT for L2 pass)
